It is unfortunate to note that the instant writ  petition was filed in the year 2003.
First order was  passed on 9th August, 2004 restraining
the  respondent from taking any step or further steps pursuant to the land acquisition before hearing of the objection under Section 5A of Act I of 1894 filed by the petitioner

. Subsequently, on 23rd August, 2005 an order was passed by a Co-ordinate Bench directing the respondent Collector to publish the award and issue notice under Section 12(2)
of Act I of 1894 to the parties.

The Collector was also directed to take necessary steps for payment of Pranabananda Khatua & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal And Ors on 13 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99150340/
1 compensation to the persons interested pursuant to the award already published in terms of the notice under Section 12(2) of the said Act.

sentences.text: The petitioners challenged the said order dated 23 rd August, 2005 in appeal being MAT No. 3593 of 2005.
The order dated 23rd August, 2005 was set aside.
The writ Court was directed to hear out the writ petition afresh.
Since then, the writ petition has not been heard.
It is submitted by Mr. Nayak, learned advocate for the petitioners that in the meantime substantial developments have been made which should be brought on record.
The petitioners may need to amend even the reliefs sought for initially in the year 2003.
Since this is a writ petition of 2003, this Court grants 10 day's time as last chance enabling the petitioners to take step.
The matter be listed on 25th September, 2023 under the same heading.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J.)
